name: Three Tree City
description: A city built in an oak, sycamore and willow along the Long River, with the Docklands and Quilted District.

description_citations.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
description_citations.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Otterfolk carry the party by boat to Three Tree City's Docklands.
timeline.quote: They arrived at the Docklands beneath the drooping tendrils of the willow

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel meets Ral Zarek, an otterfolk hunting Jace Beleren, who grabs Helga after seeing her drawing.
timeline.quote: "Ral," he replied. "Ral Zarek. I'm looking for someone named Jace Beleren."

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga describes her vision of Jace with a green and black lizardfolk and a hard-to-see creature, and Ral decides to keep her in sight.
timeline.quote: Right now, you're my only link to Beleren, so I'm not letting you out of my sight.
